gen-gf-warnes-gf-hind-vadodara: Expressive and bold, Warnes lets its ink strokes taper out before touching. Hind Vadodara works underneath with rounded glyphs and tall bowls, a tidy sans-serif partner for the stretched, spacious heading.
gen-gf-warnes-gf-karla: Warnes lets ink strokes taper out before touching, with no stroke contrast and stretched spacing. Karla, modern and approachable, feels friendlier beside it, with a gaping c and a stocky middle band.
gen-gf-warnes-gf-kedebideri: Kedebideri reads approachable and neutral, its skyward x-height line keeping rounded letters open and inviting. Warnes, meanwhile, keeps every stroke uniform, tapering its ink before it touches, so the heading stays expressive.
gen-gf-warnes-gf-krub: Krub keeps things contemporary and neutral, with a pronounced x-height. Warnes does the shouting, tapered ink strokes with spacious tracking, while Krub does the quiet work with pen-lifted curves that leave each loop unfinished.
gen-gf-warnes-gf-liter: Warnes is built to show off, ink strokes tapering out before touching. Liter, a modern plain sans, handles the quieter job, with lowercase of great vertical presence and wide mouths on round forms.
gen-gf-warnes-gf-martel-sans: Tubelike, constant-weight lines define Warnes, their ink tapering out before it touches. Martel Sans keeps things modern beside it, with generous openings in every curve and a high mean line across each word.
gen-gf-warnes-gf-matangi: Stretched ink up top, twine-like heft below, nothing delicate anywhere. Warnes tapers its strokes and spaces them wide, while Matangi, a contemporary plain sans, packs a hefty lowercase of rounded, open letters.
gen-gf-warnes-gf-maven-pro: Modern in outlook, Maven Pro keeps a gentle monotone of line thickness and a welcoming gap in the c. And paragraphs set in it should glide along easily, a quiet counterpart to Warnes.
gen-gf-warnes-gf-miriam-libre: Miriam Libre draws like wire, with an s of generous openings and a lowercase of cast-iron stature. And paragraphs in it feel approachable and modern, a steady foil to Warnes with its tapered, stretched ink.
gen-gf-warnes-gf-mozilla-headline: Ink strokes with no stroke contrast at all taper out before touching in Warnes, spaced wide and stretched. Mozilla Headline adds approachable heft, with big-bodied lowercase and a splayed c terminal.
